question: Which of the following best describes encapsulation in Java?

options.A: The ability of a class to inherit fields and methods from another class
options.B: Hiding the internal state of an object and requiring interaction through public methods
options.C: The ability of a method to take many forms at runtime
options.D: Combining multiple classes into a single hierarchy

discussion: Selected Answer: B Encapsulation is the mechanism of wrapping data (fields) and code (methods) together and restricting direct access to the data by making fields private.
Selected Answer: B Inheritance is described by option A, polymorphism by option C.

question: Which Java keyword is used to implement inheritance between classes?
discussion: Selected Answer: C The extends keyword is used when a class inherits from another class.
Selected Answer: C implements is used for interfaces, not class inheritance.

question: What is polymorphism in object-oriented programming?

options.A: The ability of an object to take many forms and allow a single interface to represent different underlying types
options.B: The restriction of direct access to object fields
options.C: The process of creating multiple instances of a class
options.D: The technique of reusing code by copying it

discussion: Selected Answer: A Polymorphism lets subclasses override methods so a single reference type can behave differently based on the actual object.
Selected Answer: A Method overriding and overloading are both forms of polymorphism in Java.

question: Which of the following is TRUE about an abstract class in Java?

options.A: It can be instantiated directly with the new keyword
options.B: It cannot contain any concrete (non-abstract) methods
options.C: It may contain both abstract and concrete methods

discussion: Selected Answer: C An abstract class can contain abstract methods, concrete methods, fields and constructors, but it cannot be instantiated directly.
Selected Answer: C It can have constructors that are called from subclasses via super().

question: What does the final keyword prevent when applied to a class?

options.C: The class from being garbage collected
options.D: The class from having static methods

discussion: Selected Answer: B A final class cannot be extended (subclassed).
Selected Answer: B final on a method prevents overriding; final on a class prevents inheritance.

question: Which access modifier makes a member visible only within its own class?
discussion: Selected Answer: D private members are accessible only inside the same class.
Selected Answer: D protected allows same package and subclasses; default allows same package only.

question: Choose two correct statements about interfaces in Java.

options.A: An interface can extend multiple other interfaces
options.B: An interface can be instantiated directly
options.C: A class can implement multiple interfaces
options.D: All methods in an interface are final

discussion: Selected Answer: AC An interface can extend multiple interfaces and a class can implement multiple interfaces.
Selected Answer: AC Java supports multiple inheritance of type through interfaces.

question: What is method overloading in Java?

options.A: Redefining a method in a subclass with the same signature
options.B: Defining multiple methods with the same name but different parameter lists
options.C: Calling a method from within itself
options.D: Binding a method call at compile time based on object type

discussion: Selected Answer: B Overloading uses the same method name with different parameters; overriding is redefining in a subclass.
Selected Answer: B Overloading is resolved at compile time.

question: Which principle states that a subclass should be substitutable for its superclass without breaking the program?
discussion: Selected Answer: C The Liskov Substitution Principle is the L in SOLID.
Selected Answer: C It requires subclasses to honor the contract of their superclass.

question: What is the purpose of the super keyword in a constructor?

options.A: To invoke the current class constructor
options.C: To create a static reference to the parent class
options.D: To prevent the class from being instantiated

discussion: Selected Answer: B super() invokes the parent class constructor and must be the first statement.
Selected Answer: B this() invokes another constructor in the same class.

question: Which of the following is a benefit of composition over inheritance?

options.A: It creates a strict compile-time type hierarchy
options.B: It allows behavior to change at runtime by swapping the contained object
options.C: It automatically shares private fields between classes
options.D: It eliminates the need for interfaces

discussion: Selected Answer: B Composition gives more flexibility because behavior can be delegated and changed dynamically.
Selected Answer: B This is often summarized as 'favor composition over inheritance'.

question: Which concept allows two classes to define methods with the same name as long as the parameter lists differ?
discussion: Selected Answer: B Overloading permits methods with the same name but different parameter lists.
Selected Answer: B Overriding requires the same signature and return type compatibility.
